entities.name: Khenra
entities.description: Jackal-headed people of Amonkhet, usually born twins, most of whom worship Hazoret.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: God worshipped by most khenra, who favors them among her viziers.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: God whose teachings inspire khenra who reject Hazoret's frenzy.

entities.name: Trial of Zeal
entities.description: Trial where twinless khenra are expected to achieve a glorified death.

events.summary: Some surviving khenra were compleated during the Phyrexian invasion after the fall of Naktamun.
events.quote: Amongst the survivors after the fall of Naktamun, some were compleated during the Phyrexian invasion.

relations.quote: Most khenra worship Hazoret , who is known to favor them among her viziers.
The Anubis-inspired Khenra ( 80 cards ) of Amonkhet
